show.description: Married in a Minute is a supernatural romantic drama filled with magic, curses, and destiny. Ananya, the last heiress of the Mystic Magic Guild, is bound by a blood pact to marry Kabir, a wealthy heir cursed with a deadly fate. As love, rivalry, and family secrets collide, their sudden magical marriage becomes a battle between power, survival, and forbidden truths.
